rules.body: Apply when durable keyed buffers outlive their view subscriptions and saving can synchronously navigate. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously." Keep these ownership lifetimes separate.

Push editor text into the existing document buffer's trailing task; restart its 120 ms quiet interval on each edit and consume only the latest pending text. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." Bind persistence to the buffer's document id rather than looking up the current view when the timer fires.

Retain reusable document buffers after consumption and badge departure. src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };" Clearing pending task state before consume permits later bursts and synchronous reentry without consuming the same pending value twice. Preserve empty text as valid text.

Preserve durable edits when open, close, or dispose departs a document: flush its pending buffer before departure returns. TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." Detach the outgoing view and stop its subscription independently of flushing its buffer; stopping the badge must not discard pending document text.

Treat flushing as a synchronous callback boundary. Publish the departing view state and finish outgoing view cleanup before saving; assign a navigation request identity before retirement and recheck it after saving before installing an outer open's destination. docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." A nested open or close must remain authoritative when the interrupted outer operation resumes.

Preserve public interfaces, store event payloads, source identities, and document text. docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." Keep preview behavior outside this change. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};" Do not generalize durable editor flushing into preview hide, which cancels transient work.

Verify with controlled timers and synchronous listeners: no editor write before 120 ms of quiet unless departure forces persistence; one latest-text write after quiet; another burst saves; empty text persists; open, close, and dispose persist outgoing pending text before returning; reopening retains document identity; a save listener's nested open or close survives the outer continuation; canceled timers do not duplicate saves. Separately verify preview's existing 40 ms delay, cancellation, and reuse. These checks operationalize TASK's "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." and "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." rather than deriving requirements from evaluation observations.

limitations: No related experiences were supplied, so there is no prior guidance to confirm, revise, or merge.
Attempt 1 reports passing examples; this does not establish causality, exhaustive correctness, or benefit across other tasks.
Throwing host callbacks and API calls after disposal have no specified recovery policy in the supplied task and public documents.
The static review hint is a review prompt, not proof of a defect or an additional requirement.
